scope: Detached, unpowered three-RS02 proximal complex fit assembly. Not a release for powered or loaded operation, CNC production, or structural polymer substitution.

manufacturer_reference.drawing: Nine M3 holes, depth 8 mm, on 73 ± 0.2 mm PCD; six M4 holes, depth 7 mm MIN, on 24 ± 0.2 mm PCD. Prototype penetration is limited to 6 mm pending physical confirmation. The 7 mm MIN callout is not a maximum. Pilot projection is 3.5 (+0/−0.3) mm with a separate 0.5 mm front step. Case length is 41.5 mm versus 41.4 mm in the reference envelope.

hardware.specification: M3 × 60 socket-head cap screw (ISO 4762) and ordinary M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm AF
hardware.seating_position: Head underside Y61; nut bears at Y5 and occupies Y2.6–5
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Measure actual screw, nut, and 41/6 mm metal tubes. No washer is needed in this preserved metal stack. Do not use M3 × 55 or ×65.

hardware.seating_position: Head underside Y3.7; motor output face Y0
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Install before the knee motor blocks the driver. Confirm actual output step and screw head.

hardware.seating_position: Head underside Y61; motor output face Y54.4
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Use the corrected through-open crank; confirm physical motor blind-hole depth.

hardware.seating_position: Head underside Y53.5; motor stator face Y50.4
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Install before the crank and outer shell. Closing the nominal 0.1 mm face gap can increase engagement to about 5.0 mm.

hardware.specification: M3 × 8 countersunk socket screw; specify DIN 7991 head dimensions
hardware.seating_position: Reference head top Y−0.9, with 0.20 mm drawdown to its conical seat
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Verify purchased head and rim dimensions, actual seating and motor thread depth; keep penetration at or below 6 mm.

hardware.seating_position: Reference head top X−52.5, with 0.20 mm drawdown
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Verify the selected DIN 7991 or ISO 10642 head. Expected penetration is about 4.0–4.5 mm; keep at or below 6 mm.

hardware.seating_position: Head underside X−50.5; motor stator face X−77.5
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Confirm actual stator face. Do not substitute 35 mm, which would reach 8 mm.

hardware.specification: M3 × 25 button-head socket screw and ordinary M3 hex nut, 5.5 mm AF
hardware.seating_position: Head underside X−48.5; nut occupies X−73 to −70.6
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Start these screws and nuts with the rear plate and roll motor absent, then fit those rear parts. This avoids nut float without changing geometry.

hardware.specification: M4 × 16 button-head socket screw, ordinary M4 nut (7 mm AF), and 4.3 ID × 9 OD × 0.8 mm washer
hardware.seating_position: Head underside Y−0.1; washer Y−0.9 to −0.1; nut Y−15.1 to −11.9
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Use the documented ordinary 7 mm wrench route and verify the purchased tool.

hardware.specification: M4 × 25 button-head screw, ordinary M4 nut, two 4.3 ID × 12 OD × 1 mm washers, and one 18 mm metal sleeve per screw
hardware.seating_position: Existing clamp floors Y58 and Y76; washers Y57–58 and Y76–77
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Use metal sleeves for clamping. Printed sleeves are fit-only; preload and creep remain unqualified.

hardware.specification: 6810-2RS, 50 x 65 x 7 mm sealed ball bearing
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Select actual bearing brand; confirm race faces, fit and measured width. No preload qualification.

hardware.specification: Metal tube, 5 mm OD / 3.4 mm ID: three at 41 mm and three at 6 mm length
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Square, deburr and measure both ends. Optional printed copies are fit-only.

hardware.specification: Metal tube, 8 mm OD / 4.4 mm ID, 18 mm length
hardware.remaining_physical_checks: Square ends and measured length; do not tighten printed substitute tubes structurally.

assembly_sequence: Fit bearings/spacers and the outer retainer in the main housing with the rear plate and motor absent; start three M3 x 25 screws and accessible M3 nuts before closing the rear.
Position the inner backplate, fit the rear stator plate and roll motor, then install the nine M3 x 30 stator screws.
Fit the cup/journal and tighten the six M4 x 25 output screws through the empty cup before installing the perpendicular hip motor.
Install the hip motor and its removable closure. Install the hip output hub with six M4 x 8 screws before the knee motor blocks those tool paths.
Fit the knee motor to its plate with nine M3 x 8 screws; install the input crank with six M4 x 12 screws before closing the outer thigh.
Assemble the three M3 x 60 pod ties, six metal sleeves and three M3 nuts; slide the corrected outer thigh axially over the preassembled module.
Tighten the three long ties through their open channels and close the two structural thigh clamps. Accessing the fifteen knee-motor screws later requires removing the outer shell.
limits: Verify physical motor-hole depth, face datums and purchased fastener/head tolerances before tightening.
Some fasteners need a staged assembly order: hipoutput before knee motor; kneestator before crank; outer shell head-entry cuts are required.
Tube stack is9.5..50.5 and55..61; bare tie head clamps the metal sleeve, not the outer polymer. Two existingM4 shell clamps retain the structural halves.
No knee axle,6001bearings,pushrod or shoulder pins required for this proximal assembly.
Metal sleeve/spacer substitution and structural strength remain separate from the printed fit test.
tools: 2 mm hex key for M3 button and countersunk heads
2.5 mm hex key for M3 cap screws and M4 button/countersunk heads
3 mm hex key for M4 socket-head cap screws
Ordinary 5.5 mm and 7 mm holding spanners; selected wrench envelopes must fit
qualification_limits: Sampled nominal rigid geometry, not a tolerance, deflection or continuous-path certification.
Detached bench assembly, unpowered and externally supported.
Catalog dimensions do not establish supplier inventory or delivery.
No claim of loaded printed strength, bearing preload, or native Fusion-derived manufacture.
